methodologyNotes: Pricing fetched from each vendor's official pricing page where accessible. Expensify's official pricing page (expensify.com/pricing) rendered as an accounting-integration settings screen (JS-rendered, no pricing visible); USD prices confirmed via softwareadvice.com and getapp.com. Zoho Expense's official page geo-locates to Germany and returns EUR prices; USD prices sourced from techrepublic.com review and getapp.com listing. SAP Concur's pricing page (concur.com/en-us/pricing) returned HTTP 403; Base/Plus prices sourced from softwareadvice.com listing. Rippling Spend has no public self-serve pricing; all tiers are quote-only. All other vendor official pages (ramp.com, brex.com, navan.com) were fetched directly and returned usable pricing data. annualDiscountPct recorded where both monthly and annual rates were explicitly published.

vendors.name: Expensify
vendors.provenance: Official pricing page (expensify.com/pricing) rendered as JS-only integration settings screen with no pricing content. USD plan prices sourced from softwareadvice.com and corroborated by getapp.com listing (both accessed 2026-06-14).

plans.name: Free
plans.notes: Free version available with basic expense tracking functionality. No corporate card management or advanced approvals.

plans.name: Collect
plans.notes: $5 per user per month. Includes receipt scanning, reimbursements, corporate card management, expense and travel approvals, travel booking, QuickBooks/Xero integrations, and AI support.

plans.name: Control
plans.notes: $9 per user per month (may vary; listed as starting at $9). Includes all Collect features plus multiple approval flows, custom expense rules, ERP integrations (NetSuite, Sage Intacct), HR integrations (Workday/Certinia), SAML/SSO, custom reporting, and budgeting.

vendors.name: Ramp
vendors.provenance: Fetched directly from ramp.com/pricing (2026-06-14). Page returned full pricing content. Corroborated by softwareadvice.com listing.

plans.name: Free
plans.notes: $0 per user per month. Includes unlimited corporate cards, expense management via SMS/Slack, basic AP automation, and foundational accounting integrations (QuickBooks Online, Xero).

plans.name: Plus
plans.notes: $15 per user per month billed monthly; 20% discount with annual billing (~$12/user/month). Includes AI-driven expense reviews, auto-coded line items, advanced ERP integrations (NetSuite, Sage Intacct), real-time budget tracking, custom user roles. 30-day free trial available. Platform fee may also apply based on team size.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Custom pricing, annual billing only. Includes dedicated account and customer success manager, priority support, custom development, ERP extensions, advanced org configuration, Workday/Oracle Fusion Cloud integrations.

vendors.name: Brex
vendors.provenance: Fetched directly from brex.com/pricing (2026-06-14). Page returned full pricing content. Corroborated by softwareadvice.com and getapp.com listings.

plans.name: Essentials
plans.notes: Free. Includes unlimited global corporate cards accepted in 210+ countries, AI-powered custom rules, accounting integrations, local currency wires, travel booking, and bill pay. Up to 2 entities.

plans.name: Premium
plans.notes: $12 per user per month. Includes multiple customizable expense policies, dynamic expense review chains, AI-powered compliance audit detection, live budgets with real-time reporting, budget delegation, policy compliance reporting. No annual discount information published.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Custom pricing. Includes unlimited US or global entities, local card issuance, global reimbursements in local currency, automated VAT tracking, non-US entity setup with KYC/KYB support, designated senior consultant.

vendors.name: Zoho Expense
vendors.provenance: Official pricing page (zoho.com/expense/pricing.html) geo-locates to Germany and displays EUR prices only; no USD option visible. USD prices sourced from techrepublic.com review and corroborated by getapp.com listing and softwareadvice.com (all accessed 2026-06-14). TechRepublic provided both monthly and annual billing rates in USD.

plans.name: Free
plans.notes: Free for up to 3 users. Includes basic expense reports, receipt storage, and basic audit trail.

plans.name: Standard
plans.notes: $3 per active user per month billed annually (confirmed against official page and G2/CostBench listings). Billed-monthly rate is higher (~$4/user/mo per official page; the prior '$5 monthly' figure was unconfirmed and removed). Includes 20 receipt autoscans/user, access delegation, basic audit trail, cash advances, corporate card reconciliation, multilevel approval.

plans.name: Premium
plans.notes: $5 per active user per month billed annually; $8 per active user per month billed monthly. Minimum 3 users. Includes advanced approval, advanced customization, per diem automation, purchase request, travel requests, unlimited receipt autoscans, online travel booking tool, live budget tracking.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: UNVERIFIED PRICE REMOVED (2026-06-14 adversarial review): The previously listed $8/$12-per-user 200-user-minimum 'Enterprise' tier could not be confirmed against Zoho's official pricing page (zoho.com/us/expense/pricing/), which publishes only Free, Standard, Premium, and a quote-only Custom tier — no priced Enterprise plan exists. Treated as quote-only. The real top tier is the separately listed 'Custom' plan.

plans.name: Custom
plans.notes: Pricing available upon request. Minimum 100 users. Includes Zoho Spend all-in-one platform with travel, expense, corporate cards, procurement, AP automation, and payroll.

vendors.name: SAP Concur
vendors.provenance: Official pricing page (concur.com/en-us/pricing) returned HTTP 403. Pricing data sourced from softwareadvice.com listing, corroborated by getapp.com listing (both accessed 2026-06-14). Base and Plus plans are described as usage-based starting prices.

plans.name: Base
plans.notes: Starting at $7/month (usage-based). Unlimited users. Includes Concur Expense core module. Actual cost scales with usage/transaction volume.

plans.name: Plus
plans.notes: Starting at $11/month (usage-based). Unlimited users. Adds ExpenseIt receipt scanning, User Support Desk, and Reporting on top of Base features.

plans.name: Premium
plans.notes: Quote-only. Includes Concur Expense, Concur Travel, ExpenseIt, User Support Desk, Reporting, Intelligence analytics, and additional enterprise features.

vendors.name: Rippling Spend
vendors.provenance: Official pricing page (rippling.com/pricing) fetched directly but returned no expense-module pricing — page only shows a 'Request a free quote' CTA. Expense management product page also confirmed quote-only approach with no published pricing.

plans.name: Rippling Spend
plans.notes: No public pricing. All tiers are quote-only. Rippling Spend includes corporate cards, expense management, and bill pay as modular add-ons to the Rippling platform.

vendors.name: Navan
vendors.provenance: Fetched directly from navan.com/pricing (2026-06-14). Page returned full pricing content for Business and Enterprise tiers with expense module pricing.

plans.name: Business
plans.notes: Free for companies up to 300 employees. Expense module: first 5 monthly expensing users included free, then $15 per user per month. Includes global travel inventory, unlimited policy and approval workflows, 24/7 travel support, rewards program, 30+ HRIS integrations.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Custom pricing. Includes all Business features plus dedicated Account Executive, dedicated Customer Success Manager, custom implementation, corporate negotiated rates, and comprehensive back-office capabilities.
